decision: Move straight from the assessment to the fix without stopping for confirmation
reason: The request said 'handle it' and that the work is done once the fix is committed on main

decision: Auto-generate the slug 'yaml-alias-set'
reason: No slug was given

decision: Rate the bug valid and high severity
reason: Reproduced: other agents' settings change silently with exit 0

decision: Mark alias occurrences with a ruamel Composer subclass that returns a stand-in node spanning the *name token and pointing at the anchored node
options: Scan the text after each key's ':' for *name
Count first vs. later encounters of a node object during build()
reason: Text scanning is fragile (comments, flow context, list items, keys that are aliases). Counting encounters finds aliases but not where the *name token is, which the expansion needs

decision: Build the stand-in from slotted subclasses (_AliasScalar/_AliasSequence/_AliasMapping) by copying slots, instead of copy.copy
Make a node's start offset skip a leading &anchor (content_start), so replacing a value keeps the anchor
reason: The node's start mark sits at the &name token, so replacing the node deleted the anchor and setting at the anchor broke

decision: Put content_start and the ALIAS_NAME/ALIAS_TARGET constants in scalars.py rather than tree.py
reason: Scalar typing also reads the node start to spot explicit tags, and this avoids a circular import

decision: Type an alias scalar as its target, and recognise an explicit tag that comes after an anchor
Refuse with exit 3 (WriteRefused) any set that goes below an alias, with a message naming the alias, &anchor and `set --expand-alias`
reason: Required by the contract

decision: Allow replacing the alias node itself (e.g. set coder.settings none), changing only the *d token; log it as an open question
reason: It replaces only the *d token and changes nobody else; the contract doesn't settle it

decision: Expansion re-plans the set on the reloaded expanded text with the expand flag still on, so any alias further down the path is also expanded
Render the copy block-style from the anchored node's plain value, so nested anchors are not duplicated and nested aliases become copies
reason: So nested anchors are not duplicated

decision: For an alias that is a list item, put the expansion comment on the dash's line ('-  # expanded from *b by troupe')
--expand-alias on a path with no alias acts as a plain set
Refuse any set whose path has a '<<' segment, instead of only refusing an expansion under <<
options: refuse in the new-key branch only
refuse any path with a << segment
reason: `set coder.<< x` would otherwise write the merge key's value

decision: Refuse an expansion when the anchored node itself holds a merge key
reason: troupe never writes a merge key

decision: --expand-alias refuses (exit 3) for an alias inside a flow collection
reason: A block-style copy can't go inside a flow collection

decision: Refuse an expansion whose final write would land in a different file, rather than splitting it across two files
Refuse with exit 3 when the expanded text fails to load back, writing nothing
When the alias line already has a comment, put the expansion comment in front of it
Leave merge-key semantics on read out of scope (<< stays an ordinary key)
reason: The contract only requires that troupe never writes merge keys

decision: Leave recursive anchors (a: &a [*a]) unhandled
reason: They were already unsupported before this change

decision: Verifier: an alias takes its anchor's identity; replacing an alias token is verified only at PATH; verification runs against plan.basis
reason: Setting at an anchor must be verified at every alias, while replacing an alias changes it alone

decision: Add an EditPlan.basis field to carry the expanded configuration the plan was made on
reason: --expand-alias plans the set on the expanded text

decision: Add _after_properties so empty, block and collection rewrites keep the &name on the key's line
Add an is_alias TypeGuard and an Alias type alias
reason: mypy needed alias nodes narrowed away from TextInclude

decision: Treat the earlier test_file_without_final_newline failure as a half-written-code artifact and don't investigate further
reason: It passed on re-run; the planner had probably imported alias.py before it existed

decision: Put the 13 new e2e tests in a new file tests/e2e/test_set_alias.py, including a history check that only one event is recorded
Check the new tests against the pre-fix code by stashing src/
Add the expand_alias keyword to the stand-in planner in tests/unit/test_verify.py
reason: Four tests failed without it; the previous step made the same change for in_include

decision: Document --expand-alias in the README with a before/after example
Commit directly to main, no push or PR, and amend the commit to update fix.md with the full-suite result
Mark the fix verified and recommend closing the bug, deciding the alias-replacement open question separately
reason: Every reproduction step was re-run through the real CLI on the committed code

decision: Convergence: report no gaps for 005 and leave tasks.md unmodified
reason: All of 005's FRs, SCs and decisions were checked; 005's own tests pass

decision: Recommend /method-command for a step 6 spec rather than adding the alias work to 005's tasks
reason: No feature spec describes the Aliases behaviour yet, the constitution needs spec, code and tests to agree, and this command can't change a different feature's tasks.md

decision: Accept that adding a new key under an anchored include string is refused with exit 3, leaving it for a step 6 spec
reason: It is the safe outcome and 005 doesn't cover this case
